title: Aggregations, HAVING and conditional metrics
summary: Group only after defining the intended grain and metric semantics.

blocks.text: Group only after defining the intended grain and metric semantics.

items: WHERE filters input rows before aggregation; HAVING filters groups after aggregation.
COUNT(*) counts rows; COUNT(col) ignores NULL values.
Conditional aggregates let one scan compute several metrics.
Beware summing a measure after a join that duplicated the original grain.

blocks.code:
SELECT country,
       COUNT(*) AS customers,
       SUM(CASE WHEN active THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_customers
FROM customer_snapshot
GROUP BY country
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10;
